title: Spicy Moroccan Chili Bean Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy stir fry made with the bold flavors of Morocco, featuring chili peppers and beans. Serve over rice or with some crusty bread.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the crushed or chopped dried red chili peppers and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the diced tomato and cook until the mixture is heated through.
Stir in the adventurous spice blend.
Add the canned black beans and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the Spicy Moroccan Chili Bean Stir Fry over rice or with some crusty bread.
Garnish with crispy fried onions and additional chili peppers if desired.
